organization_note: OpenAI Group PBC, a public benefit corporation controlled by the nonprofit OpenAI Foundation, develops the models and runs the products; the October 2025 recapitalization set this structure. Its privacy policy names OpenAI OpCo, LLC, of San Francisco. One name, OpenAI, covers the models, the API, and the specifications it co-stewards.
